title: Waymo LLC: Vehicle May Fail to Remain Stopped for Traffic Control Hand Gestures
hazard: Proceeding into an intersection under manual traffic control without permission increases the risk of a crash.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS) operating a software version prior to the September 17, 2026 release. The vehicle may fail to remain stopped after initially stopping for traffic control hand gestures from law enforcement.
remedy: Waymo has updated the ADS software, free of charge. All affected vehicles were repaired by November 6, 2026.

title: Waymo LLC: Software May Allow Vehicle to Drive in Closed Lane on Freeway
hazard: Driving in a closed lane on a freeway increases the risk of a crash.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The software may allow the vehicle to enter a closed freeway lane and continue driving at speed.
remedy: Beginning November 11, 2026, Waymo modified the scope of operations to avoid conditions that presented an increased likelihood of encountering closed freeway lanes. The final remedy is currently under development.

title: Electrical Appliances: Chargeur universel pour tondeuses
hazard: Electric_Shock. The internal wires of the product connected to the mains are not fixed correctly. In addition, the insulation distance between the live parts connected to the mains and the accessible parts is insufficient. Consequently, the user may receive an electric shock.
description: Electric charger with input voltage: 100-240 V AC, output: 3.6 V DC, input current: 0.3 A and output: 1.5 A. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

title: Electrical Appliances: Girlanda
hazard: Electric_Shock. The live parts of the lamp cap are accessible when the lamp is partially screwed into the lampholder of the luminaire, leading to electric shock. Consequently, the user could touch accessible live parts and receive an electric shock.
description: LED-lighting chain. AC Mains pluggable with non-detachable power supply cord, class II, 16 A round plug. E27 lamp holders. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive and the relevant European standard EN IEC 60598.

title: Toys: Kids music turtle crab toy
hazard: Choking. The toy has small parts (label) that can easily detach. A small child could put them in the mouth and choke.
description: Musical toy in the shape of a turtle made of hard plastic, featuring buttons and light and sound effects. The toy is battery-operated. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.

title: Toys: Ride-on toy car
hazard:
Choking. The toy has small parts (plastic components, stickers and part of a connector) that can easily detach and break. A small child could put them in the mouth and choke.
In addition, when opening the battery compartment the screw comes completely loose, posing an additional risk of choking.
description: Ride-on toy car with a unicorn made of hard plastic with pink, brown and light blue colours. The toy is battery-operated and features light and sound effects. The product does not comply with the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1 and the European standard EN 62115.
